results.question: Which device had the highest average CPU percentage over all recorded samples? Return its hostname and average CPU rounded to two decimals. Break ties by hostname.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT d.hostname, ROUND(AVG(dm.cpu_pct), 2) AS average_cpu
FROM device_metrics dm
JOIN devices d ON dm.device_id = d.id
GROUP BY dm.device_id
ORDER BY average_cpu DESC, d.hostname ASC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: For November 3, 2026 UTC, count monitoring samples per site. Return site name and count, ordered by site name.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT s.name AS site_name, COUNT(dm.device_id) AS sample_count
FROM sites s
JOIN devices d ON s.id = d.site_id
JOIN device_metrics dm ON d.id = dm.device_id
WHERE dm.collected_at >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00' AND dm.collected_at < '2026-11-04 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.name
ORDER BY s.name;

results.question: Which devices never recorded CPU above 80%? Return only hostname, sorted alphabetically.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT d.hostname
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN device_metrics dm ON d.id = dm.device_id AND dm.cpu_pct > 80
WHERE dm.device_id IS NULL
ORDER BY d.hostname ASC
LIMIT 100;

results.question: Which sites have at least 10 samples above 80% CPU over the full dataset? Return site name and high-CPU sample count, ordered by site name.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS high_cpu_sample_count
FROM device_metrics dm
JOIN devices d ON dm.device_id = d.id
JOIN sites s ON d.site_id = s.id
WHERE dm.cpu_pct > 80
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY s.name
LIMIT 100;

results.question: For each UTC date with CPU readings above 80%, return the date as YYYY-MM-DD and number of such samples, sorted by date.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUBSTR(collected_at, 1, 10) AS date, 
    COUNT(*) AS high_cpu_samples
FROM 
    device_metrics
WHERE 
    cpu_pct > 80
GROUP BY 
    date
ORDER BY 
    date;

results.question: How many recorded monitoring samples belong to routers rather than switches? Return only the count.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(dm.device_id) 
FROM device_metrics dm 
JOIN devices d ON dm.device_id = d.id 
WHERE d.device_type = 'router';

results.question: Which site had the most minutes of downtime?
Which devices had the highest average CPU yesterday?
results.generated_sql:
WITH cpu_averages AS (
  SELECT
    device_id,
    AVG(cpu_pct) AS avg_cpu
  FROM device_metrics
  WHERE collected_at >= date('now', '-1 day', 'start of day')
    AND collected_at < date('now', 'start of day')
  GROUP BY device_id
)
SELECT d.hostname, cpu_averages.avg_cpu
FROM cpu_averages
JOIN devices d ON cpu_averages.device_id = d.id
ORDER BY cpu_averages.avg_cpu DESC, d.hostname
LIMIT 100;
